que_es: Percentage of the hemoglobin in the blood that is carrying oxygen.

como_se_mide_en_vuelo.estacion: Sensor always at the same site (finger or forehead), and the site noted. Warm hand and 30 seconds without moving.
como_se_mide_en_vuelo.superficie: Same as on station. In exploration atmosphere, compare with the profile baseline.

por_que: Detects hypoxia: the exploration atmosphere (8.2 psia, 34% O2) is mildly hypoxic.
referencia_en_vuelo: In that atmosphere the inspired O2 pressure is 128 mmHg, equivalent to an altitude of about 1,220 m. Ground-based evidence indicates that the forehead is less affected than the finger by peripheral vasoconstriction.
cuando_avisar: Extreme band of layer A (91% or less). From 92 to 95% it adds points only if it also departs from the profile baseline.
prevencion: Cabin atmosphere control to keep the partial pressure of oxygen within the NASA-STD-3001 limits, with continuous monitoring.
fuentes: Royal College of Physicians: NEWS2 scoring table
NASA HRP: Risks of Human Spaceflight
